55400.meaning1: causes to plant; makes grow; causes to cultivate
55400.commentary: (DNa) ropāpesī'ti nānāvaṇṇauppalabīj'ādīni tato tato āharāpetvā na ropāpesi, saha citt'uppāden'eva pan'assa sabbaṃ ijjhati. taṃ loko raññā ropitan'ti maññi. tena vuttaṃ, ropāpesī'ti. tato paṭṭhāya mahājano nānappakāraṃ jalajathalajamālaṃ piḷandhitvā nakkhattaṃ kīḷamāno viya gacchati.

examples.text: pāpasamācāro'ti mālāvacchaṃ ropeti'pi ropāpeti'pi, siñcati'pi siñcāpeti'pi, ocināti'pi ocināpeti'pi, gantheti'pi ganthāpeti'pi.
ropite vihesake saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
saṅghikāni, bhikkhave, bījāni puggalikāya bhūmiyā ropitāni bhāgaṃ datvā paribhuñjitabbāni. puggalikāni bījāni saṅghikāya bhūmiyā ropitāni bhāgaṃ datvā paribhuñjitabbānī'ti.

55403.commentary: (VINa) yaṃ manussānaṃ upabhogaparibhogaṃ ropiman'ti khettaṃ vā hotu nāḷiker'ādiārāmo vā, yattha katthaci ropimaharitaṭṭhāne etāni vatthūni chaḍḍentiyā purimanayen'eva āpattibhedo veditabbo. (PYt) ropiya'ti asmin'ti ropiyaṃ, taṃ'y'eva ropimaṃ yakārassa makāraṃ katvā.

55405.meaning1: (of an arrow shaft) custom grown; purposefully cultivated
55405.commentary: (MNa) ropiman'ti ropetvā vaḍḍhitaṃ saravanato saraṃ gahetvā kataṃ.
55405.notes: The two types of arrow shaft differ between growing wild and being cultivated for that purpose.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ kaṇḍaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yadi vā gacchaṃ yadi vā ropiman'ti

55408.commentary: (ANt) byañjanaṃ kathaṃ ropetabban'ti, bhante, idaṃ byañjanaṃ ayaṃ saddo kathaṃ imasmiṃ atthe ropetabbo, kena pakārena imassa atthassa vācako jāto. nirūpetabban'ti vā pāṭho, nirūpetabbaṃ ayaṃ sabhāvanirutti katham'ettha nirūḷhā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: pāpasamācāro'ti mālāvacchaṃ ropeti'pi ropāpeti'pi, siñcati'pi siñcāpeti'pi, ocināti'pi ocināpeti'pi, gantheti'pi ganthāpeti'pi.

55410.meaning1: to plant; to grow; to cultivate

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, eko puriso khette bījaṃ ropetvā attano yathābalavīriyena vinā pākāravatiyā dhaññaṃ uddhareyya, eko puriso khette bījaṃ ropetvā vanaṃ pavisitvā kaṭṭhañ'ca sākhañ'ca chinditvā vatipākāraṃ katvā dhaññaṃ uddhareyya.

55420.meaning1: having regurgitated; having chewed the cud
55420.meaning2: having chewed the cud, having munched

examples.text: mahesayaṃ avantīnaṃ, sovīrānañ'ca rorukaṃ, mithilā ca videhānaṃ, campā aṅgesu māpitā, bārāṇasī ca kāsīnaṃ, ete govindamāpitā'ti.

55423.commentary: (SNa) roruvan'ti, dve roruvā dhūmaroruvo ca jālaroruvo ca.

examples.text: ye keci ariyaṃ dhammaṃ, vigarahantā caranti dummedhā, upenti roruvaṃ ghoraṃ, cirarattaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavanti.
agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabbo. anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabbo. akkodh'ūpāyāsaṃ nissāya kodh'ūpāyāso pahātabbo. anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo.

rosako kadariyo ca, pāp'iccho maccharī saṭho, ahiriko anottappī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

55428.meaning2: making angry, causing anger, being angry

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosantaṃ paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti.
na c'āpi sotthi bhattāraṃ, issāvādena rosaye, bhattu ca garuno sabbe, paṭipūjeti paṇḍitā.

55431.commentary: (DNa) rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesī'ti rosikā'ti evaṃ itthiliṅgavasena laddhanāmaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi. so kira bhagavato āgamanaṃ sutvā cintesi, vihāraṃ gantvā diṭṭhaṃ nāmaṃ bhāro, gehaṃ pana āṇāpetvā passissāmi c'eva yathāsatti ca āgantukabhikkhaṃ dassāmī'ti, tasmā evaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi.

examples.text: atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma rosike, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ app'ābādhaṃ app'ātaṅkaṃ lah'uṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha

55433.grammar: prp of pass of rosiyati, caus, trans (+acc)
55433.meaning1: being irritated; being annoyed; being angered; being infuriated

examples.text: app'eva nāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ, yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāran'ti.
hantā labhati hantāraṃ, jetāraṃ labhate jayaṃ, akkosako ca akkosaṃ, rosetārañ'ca rosako, atha kammavivaṭṭena, so vilutto viluppatī'ti.
tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhavedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca?
yo mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā, bhātaraṃ bhaginiṃ sasuṃ, hanti roseti vācāya, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā rohaṇo ca pekhuṇiyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

55443.meaningLit: for the sake of causing to grow

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso vaṇaṃ ālimpeyya yāva'd'eva rohan'atthāya, seyyathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāva'd'eva bhārassa nittharaṇ'atthāya

55446.meaning1: (in names of several plants and animals) red; red coloured

examples.text: mūlabījaṃ nāma, haliddi, siṅgiveraṃ, vacā, vacattaṃ, ativisā, kaṭukarohiṇī, usīraṃ, bhaddamūttakaṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi mūle jāyanti, mūle sañjāyanti, etaṃ mūlabījaṃ nāma.
n'atthi, samma, sabbāni khīṇānī'ti. tena hi mayā attano atthāya vālukāya nikhaṇitvā cattāro rohitamacchā ṭhapitā, sace bhikkhuṃ bhojetu'kāmo'si, ime gahetvā gacchā'ti te macche tassa adāsi.
bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅ'gamo.

55455.meaning1: name of the people previously living on Vepulla mountain

examples.text: rohitassānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. rohitassā, bhikkhave, manussā vaṅkakaṃ pabbataṃ tīhena ārohanti, tīhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

55457.meaning1: (gram) letter l; 36th letter of the alphabet; dental semi-vowel

examples.text: 488, 481. ha vipariyayo lo vā.
hakārassa vipariyayo hoti yapaccaye pare, yapaccayassa ca lo hoti vā. vulhati, vuyhati.

55460.commentary: (UDa) cūḷavaggassa paṭhame lakuṇḍakabhaddiyan'ti ettha bhaddiyo'ti tassa āyasmato nāmaṃ, kāyassa pana rassattā lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo'ti naṃ sañjānanti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mañjussarānaṃ yadidaṃ lakuṇṭaka bhaddiyo.

55461.commentary: (UDa) cūḷavaggassa paṭhame lakuṇḍakabhaddiyan'ti ettha bhaddiyo'ti tassa āyasmato nāmaṃ, kāyassa pana rassattā lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo'ti naṃ sañjānanti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mañjussarānaṃ yadidaṃ lakuṇḍaka bhaddiyo.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ lakuṇḍakabhaddiyaṃ anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.

55462.notes: Theragāthā verses 466-472 (TH7.2, TH225) are attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ lakuṇḍakabhaddiyaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi, passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpan'ti?
vāhasataṃ kho, mahārāja, vīhīnaṃ aḍḍhacūḷañ'ca vāhā vīhisatt'ambaṇāni dve ca tumbā ek'accharākkhaṇe pavattacittassa ettakā vīhī lakkhaṃ ṭhapīyamānā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyyuṃ?

55468.commentary: (PVa) lakkho eso, mahārāja, satabhāgavassakoṭiyo'ti satabhāgā satakoṭṭhāsā vassakoṭiyo, mahārāja, niraye paccantānaṃ sattānaṃ āyuno eso lakkho eso paricchedo'ti attho. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, dasadasakaṃ sataṃ nāma, dasa satāni sahassaṃ nāma, dasadasasahassāni satasahassaṃ nāma, satasatasahassāni koṭi nāma, tāsaṃ koṭīnaṃ vasena satasahassavassakoṭiyo satabhāgā vassakoṭiyo. sā ca kho nerayikānaṃ'y'eva vassagaṇanāvasena veditabbā, na manussānaṃ, devānaṃ vā. īdisāni anekāni vassakoṭisatasahassāni nerayikānaṃ āyu.

examples.text: vassāni satasahassāni, ghoso suyyati tāva'd'e, lakkho eso mahārāja, satabhāgavassakoṭiyo.

atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadah'uposathe udānaṃ udānesi, ramaṇīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, abhirūpā vata bho dosinā ratti, dassanīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, pāsādikā vata bho dosinā ratti, lakkhaññā vata bho dosinā ratti.
muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī, agamī buddhavarassa santikaṃ, passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, cakkhu āsi yathā purāṇakan'ti.
dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.

55471.meaning1: (interpreting of) auspicious signs; birthmarks; prognosticative marks

examples.text: āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. katamāni tīṇi? uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī'ti.
muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī, agamī buddhavarassa santikaṃ, passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, cakkhu āsi yathā purāṇakan'ti.

55473.meaning1: main characteristic; characteristic feature; salient feature

examples.text: lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.

idha, bhikkhave, gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti

55476.commentary: (SNa) lakkhaṇasaṃyutte yv'āyaṃ āyasmā ca lakkhaṇo'ti lakkhaṇatthero vutto, esa jaṭilasahass'abbhantare ehibhikkh'ūpasampadāya upasampanno ādittapariyāy'āvasāne arahattaṃ patto eko mahāsāvako'ti veditabbo. yasmā pan'esa lakkhaṇasampannena sabb'ākāraparipūrena brahmasamena attabhāvena samannāgato, tasmā lakkhaṇo'ti saṅkhaṃ gato.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā lakkhaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, āvuso moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyā'ti? akālo kho, āvuso lakkhaṇa, etassa pañhassa.

55477.meaning1: having the quality of; with characteristics

examples.text: lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho'ti yattha katthaci lubbhanalakkhaṇo lobho ca, dussanalakkhaṇo doso ca, majjanalakkhaṇo mado ca, muyhanalakkhaṇo moho ca.

55478.commentary: (ANa) na lakkhaṇakusalo'ti gāvīnaṃ sarīre kataṃ dhanusattisūl'ādi-bhedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ na jānāti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti

55479.meaning1: skilled in characteristics; expert in qualities
55479.commentary: (ANa) na lakkhaṇakusalo hotī'ti kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito'ti evaṃ vuttaṃ kusal'ākusalakammaṃ paṇḍitabālalakkhaṇanti na jānāti.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
taṃ lakkhaṇaññū bahavo samāgatā, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, uṇṇā ca lomā ca yathā susaṇṭhitā, upavattatī īdisakaṃ bahujjano.

55481.meaning1: fortune teller; soothsayer; diviner; interpreter of signs

examples.text: veyyañjanikā'ti lakkhaṇapāṭhakā.

55483.meaning2: salient feature, essential function, manifestation and proximate cause

55490.meaning1: meditating on characteristics; meditation based on (the three) qualities

examples.text: jhāyanto'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānena ca ārammaṇ'ūpanijjhānena ca jhāyanto. lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ nāma vipassanāmaggaphalāni. vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.
accaṅkuso'va nāgo'va, jitaṃ me tuttatomaraṃ, kāraṇaṃ nappajānāmi, sammatto lakkhaṇ'ūruyā.
harīyamāno dhataraṭṭho, sumukhaṃ etadabravi, bāḷhaṃ bhāyāmi sumukha, sāmāya lakkhaṇ'ūruyā, asmākaṃ vadham'aññāya, ath'attānaṃ vadhissati.

55494.meaning2: good luck, prosperity, deity of wealth

55496.meaning2: having marked, having distinguished, having characterised
